user_instructions: Recover the itinerary from the heavy-rain disruption while preserving mandatory constraints.
additional_instructions: Preserve all unaffected original activities provisionally. Address the outdoor activities affected by heavy rain. You may reschedule outdoor activities to times before 12:00 PM if the schedule and available walking estimates support feasibility. Alternatively, you may replace affected outdoor activities with indoor alternatives, but only when retrieved evidence supports their availability. Do not invent venue availability, activity details, or travel estimates. Do not assume that moving an activity earlier is feasible when required travel estimates are missing. If neither recovery approach can be established as feasible, return a partial proposal and explain what remains unresolved. Preserve the mandatory Natural History Museum visit. Explain schedule changes and remaining uncertainties. All activity start times must use Washington, DC local time. Preserve the original itinerary's timezone convention. Do not convert activity times to UTC or append Z to timestamps. Use only the supplied directed walking estimates. Do not assume that a route estimate is interchangeable with its reverse direction. Do not invent or infer travel estimates for missing routes.
